editorial.blurb: Bowls of Rice serves up fresh, generously portioned rice bowls with expertly grilled proteins and a personal touch that keeps customers coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the grilled chicken jalapeño bowl for consistent, packed-with-flavor results, and don't miss the Crab Rangoon—reviewers rave it's some of the best they've had.
signatureDishes: Grilled Steak Rice Bowl with Garlic Butter Fried Rice
